name: screenshot
description: Capture the current screen as an image (1280x720).

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

name: left_click
description:
Left-click at a pixel coordinate. Returns the settled post-click screenshot,
or says the screen did not change — no follow-up call needed to see the result.

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

name: right_click
description:
Right-click at a pixel coordinate. Returns the settled post-click screenshot,
or says the screen did not change.

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

name: left_click_drag
description:
Press at (x1, y1), drag to (x2, y2), release. Use to play a card onto a target.
Returns the settled post-drag screenshot.

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

x1.description: Where the drag starts, pixels from the left.

y1.description: Where the drag starts, pixels from the top.

x2.description: Where the drag ends, pixels from the left.

y2.description: Where the drag ends, pixels from the top.

name: mouse_move
description:
Move the cursor without clicking. Returns the settled post-move screenshot —
hover an enemy and read its intent tooltip from the returned image in one step.

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

name: key
description:
Press a key or combo, xdotool style: "Return", "Escape", "ctrl+s".
Returns the settled post-press screenshot.

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

keys.description: The key or combination to press.

name: scroll
description:
Scroll the wheel with the cursor at a coordinate. Returns the settled
post-scroll screenshot.

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

name: wait_for_change
description:
Wait until the screen changes, then return a screenshot.

Rarely needed: every action already returns a settled post-action
screenshot. Reach for this only when you expect a LONG animation or a
delayed change (loading screens, act transitions, multi-second enemy
turns). If nothing changed it says so and returns no image, because
the screen is identical to the last one you were shown.

intent.description: One sentence on why, in your own voice.

timeout.description: Give up after this many seconds. 10 is usually right; 30 max.

name: memory
description:
Memory tool for managing persistent information.

View your memory directory at the start of your work to recover
any earlier progress. As you work, record important findings,
intermediate results, and status to memory — your context window
may be compacted at any point, so information not saved to memory
can be lost.

Keep memory organized: update or remove stale entries rather than
accumulating. Do not create new files unless necessary.

command.description:
Command to execute (view, create, str_replace, insert, delete,
rename)

path.description:
Required parameter for `view`, `create`, `str_replace`, `insert`,
and `delete` commands. Path to file or directory in /memories, e.g.
`/memories/file.txt` or `/memories/dir`.

file_text.description:
Required parameter for `create` command, with the content
of the file to be created.

old_str.description:
Required parameter for `str_replace` command containing the
string in `path` to replace.

new_str.description:
Optional parameter for `str_replace` command containing the
new string (if not given, the string will be deleted).

insert_line.description:
Required parameter for `insert` command. The `insert_text`
will be inserted AFTER the line `insert_line` of `path`.

insert_text.description:
Required parameter for `insert` command containing the
text to insert.

view_range.description:
Optional parameter for `view` command when `path` points
to a file. If none is given, the full file is shown. If provided,
the file will be shown in the indicated line number range, e.g. [11, 12]
will show lines 11 and 12. Indexing at 1 to start. Setting `[start_line, -1]`
shows all lines from `start_line` to the end of the file.

old_path.description:
Required parameter for `rename` command containing the current
path.

new_path.description:
Required parameter for `rename` command containing the target
path.

name: queue_actions

intent.description: One sentence on the plan, in your own voice.

steps.description: The inputs to run, in order.

name: wiki_search
description:
Search the Slay the Spire community wiki (slaythespire.wiki.gg), the
only site this tool reaches. Good for enemy move sets and intents, card
and relic text and pools, events, map encounters and act structure.
Returns up to five matching pages as title, URL and snippet; pass a URL
to wiki_fetch to read the whole page. No match means the wiki has no
such page (try other words), not that the thing does not exist.

query.description: what to look for, in plain words (no site: prefix needed).

name: wiki_fetch
description:
Read one page of the Slay the Spire community wiki: the article body
as markdown (headings, paragraphs, tables), without site navigation.

url.description:
the page address, on https://slaythespire.wiki.gg/ (as returned
by wiki_search). Any other host is refused.

name: give_up
description:
Stop playing and END THIS SESSION. It counts as a loss and cannot be undone.

Only for a game that is UNRECOVERABLY stuck: a blank or frozen screen
that stayed blank after the harness relaunched the game, controls that
do nothing for many turns in a row, a run that cannot be continued.
Never because a fight or a run is going badly -- play those out.

reason.description: What is stuck and what you already tried. Goes in the log.
